name: Stroke Text
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the one-line effect description only; no upstream source was read. An outlined display headline is a staple editorial treatment and costs almost nothing as pure CSS.

fillColor.description: Colour of solid words and of the hover fill.

fillOnHover.description: Fill the outline from the bottom up on hover or focus.

a11y: The text is never split or cloned; screen readers read the headline once, as written.
Outlined glyphs have little ink, so use it only at display sizes (about 32px and up) with a stroke colour that passes 3:1 against the background.
The hover fill also runs on :focus-within, so keyboard users get the same state as pointer users.
Forced-colors mode drops the outline and paints the text solid in CanvasText; reduced motion makes the hover fill instant.
